card.name: Device use and replacement instructions
card.fires_on: Small words and spaces just before a number or phrase in device handling rules, such as 'every', 'within', 'more than', 'for single-patient-use'. It appears in administration instructions for pens, syringes, sprays and IV sets.

modes.label: Before a time count
modes.description: The space or word right before a number of hours, minutes or days in a use or replacement rule.
modes.example: It is recommended that intravenous administration apparatus be replaced at least once every<< >>24 hours.

modes.label: Single-patient pen wording
modes.description: The word 'single' in 'for single-patient-use only' on pen devices.
modes.example: The SOLIQUA 100/33 prefilled pen is for<< single>>-patient-use only [see Warnings

modes.label: Linking word in preparation steps
modes.description: A linking word such as 'for' or 'when' in preparation or priming instructions.
modes.example: follow directions below before preparing<< for>> administration.

card.writes: It suppresses words for handheld devices and instruments, so it makes such words less likely to come next.
